newsitem.title: USA: N.Y.C rejects move to lengthen officials' terms.
newsitem.headline: N.Y.C rejects move to lengthen officials' terms.

text.p: New York City voters turned down a proposal that would have amended the City Charter and given elected officials longer terms in office.
As a result, the existing term limits of eight years stand. Experts say these results show the voters' discontent with career politicians.
The City Council had fought hard for extending terms to 12 years, saying that the shorter limit will result in the loss of valuable expertise.
